task_text: 核查以下声明，搜索外部证据。依据实际证据回答，说明结论范围与不确定性：US Rep Mark Pocan stated on January 16, 2020 in a tweet: “There’s an Amazon distribution center that was advertising, last time I was there, up to $12.75 an hour. Your parents made that three decades ago.”（声明日期：2020-01-16）
task_text_en: Fact-check the following claim by searching for external evidence. Answer based on the evidence actually obtained, and state the scope of the conclusion and its uncertainties: US Rep Mark Pocan stated on January 16, 2020 in a tweet: “There’s an Amazon distribution center that was advertising, last time I was there, up to $12.75 an hour. Your parents made that three decades ago.” (claim date: 2020-01-16)
claims: US Rep Mark Pocan stated on January 16, 2020 in a tweet: “There’s an Amazon distribution center that was advertising, last time I was there, up to $12.75 an hour. Your parents made that three decades ago.”

requirements.text: 外部可靠来源对声明所述事件的记载（谁、何时、何地、发生了什么）
requirements.text_en: What reliable external sources record about the event the claim describes (who, when, where, what happened)

requirements.text: 未能确定的内容与结论的适用范围
requirements.text_en: What could not be determined and the scope of the conclusion
